chapter_title: A Letter to God (including 'Dust of Snow' & 'Fire and Ice')
storyboard: 1815: Congress of Vienna restores conservative monarchies.
summary: Explores how nationalism reshaped 19th-century Europe from multi-ethnic autocratic empires into unified modern nation-states.
key_takeaways: Napoleonic reforms modernized administration but sparked anti-French sentiment.
Bismarck and Cavour led German and Italian unifications.
